svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.14.5.2 Sump Pits
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.14 DRAINAGE
Sump Pits

g.text: Cover: resists removal by children, airtight
Not less than 0.25 m² (2.69 ft²) in area
The pit and its cover, Sentences (1) and (2)
Discharge to a sewer, drainage ditch

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Where a sump pit is provided it is
(a) not less than 750 mm (29½″) deep, (b) not
less than 0.25 m² (2.69 ft²) in area, and (c)
provided with a cover.
Covers for sump pits are designed to resist
removal by children, and to be airtight in
accordance with Sentence 9.25.3.3.(7)
Sentence 9.25.3.3.(7): sump pit covers installed
through assemblies with an air barrier system are
weatherstripped around their perimeters to
prevent air leakage.
Where gravity drainage is not practical, an
automatic sump pump discharges the water from
the sump pit into a sewer, drainage ditch or
dry well
Drawn: a sump pit cut through the basement floor, cover cut back. Pit form and pump are one example.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.14.5.2. (page 9-116)
